label: Dialogue Feed
description: Live conversation diary. Agent and user messages appear as role-coloured speech bubbles, auto-scrolling as the conversation grows.

label: Session Review
description: Read-only review of a saved conversation including LLM-generated system annotations shown in grey. Reload by calling user-cue-service:loadFeed.

label: Sensor Chart
description: Line chart that updates live as a variable changes. Bind a Chart.js-compatible JSON dataset (labels + values) to sensor_data.

label: Heartbeat Overlay
description: Pulsing SVG heart whose beat rate and colour are driven by VSM variables. Designed as a transparent overlay.

label: Breathing Overlay
description: Expanding/contracting circle whose breathing rate and colour are driven by VSM variables. Designed as a transparent overlay.

label: Chat Interview
description: Full chat UI with avatar header, auto-scrolling conversation feed, and text input. Agent bubbles appear left, user bubbles right. Ideal for intake interviews and dialogue bots.

variables.name: conversation_log
variables.description: JSON array of messages appended by appendMessage()

variables.name: user_input
variables.description: Set to the user's typed text when they press Enter or Send

label: Question Buttons
description: Three-option choice screen. Each button sends a value to gui_choice. Fully pre-authored — replace labels and sendsValue fields to match your scenario.

variables.name: gui_choice
variables.description: Receives the chosen option value when a button is clicked
